ACKS-IMPORTER.gs.title: Getting Started — ACKS II Content
ACKS-IMPORTER.gs.intro: This module streams rules text straight from your own ACKS II PDFs — nothing is copied into the world. Each player (and the GM) connects their own copy of the books on their own computer.
ACKS-IMPORTER.gs.connectBody: Point this browser at your PDF copy of each book you own. The file is read locally each session; only its location is remembered on this device.
ACKS-IMPORTER.gs.gmBody: With your books connected, one click imports everything the cookbook ships: proficiencies & powers, equipment, monsters & NPCs, location journals, roll tables, and rules tables. Safe to run again later — nothing is duplicated.
ACKS-IMPORTER.gs.importDone: Done — see the chat log and notifications for details.
ACKS-IMPORTER.gs.later: You can reopen this any time from the "{folder}" compendium (Getting Started macro), and everything here also exists as individual macros.
ACKS-IMPORTER.gs.dismiss: Don't show this automatically again (this seat)
ACKS-IMPORTER.gs.settingHint: When unchecked, the Getting Started walkthrough opens on join for this seat until a book has been connected.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.connectNote: This browser can't reopen a file by itself (no File System Access API — usually an insecure origin, or Firefox). The file's NAME is remembered, so a page reload puts the book straight back and a later session offers it back with a picker. It is read locally only; nothing uploads, and the text is never stored.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.connectNoteFsa: You'll pick the PDF next. Its LOCATION is remembered on this device (the text itself is never stored) — each session re-reads the actual file, so keeping the book is required.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.connectBulkNote: Select as many books as you like, then pick their files in one go — each file goes to the book it belongs to, whatever order you pick them in. Extra files beyond the books you chose are matched the same way; anything that can't be placed is named so you can connect it on its own.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.connectBulkUnmatched: couldn't tell which book these are — select those books in the list and pick their files again: {files}
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.connectUnfilled: no file was picked for these, so they are still closed: {books}
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.connectNoBook: Choose at least one book to connect.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.connectWrongBook: that file is {actual}, not {book} — it was not read, so nothing is imported from the wrong book. Connect {actual} on its own, or pick the right file for {book}.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.locationSaved: {book}: location remembered on this device. Descriptions stay in memory only.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.locationNameOnly: {book}: this browser can't reopen files on its own, so only the name "{name}" is remembered — you'll be offered it again next session.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.locationNotSaved: {book} is open and readable, but this browser wouldn't let its location be remembered — you'll be asked for the file again next session.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectBody: These books are remembered on this seat but not open yet. Browsers ask for permission per file, per session — each book has its own control, and when several are waiting the all-at-once picker takes them in one trip.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectFailed: could not be opened. If the file moved, use Connect Your Book.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectHandle: remembered as {where} — one click unlocks it.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectUrlFailed: could not be read at {where} — has it moved?
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectFile: Last time this was "{name}". This browser can't reopen it on its own — choose it again.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectIncomplete: still not open: {books} — use Connect Your Book if the file moved.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectAllOpen: every remembered book is already open this session: {books}.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectNothing: no book locations remembered on this seat — connect one and it will be offered on every future join.
ACKS-IMPORTER.cache.settingName: Keep books open across a page reload (seconds)
ACKS-IMPORTER.cache.settingHint: Foundry reloads often, and on a remote seat every reload used to mean re-picking each PDF. For this many seconds after the page goes away, your books reopen by themselves. It is a bridge across a reload, not a copy of the book: leave the table for longer than this and it empties, as does Forget Books. 0 turns it off.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectAllNote: Pick every PDF in one go — they're matched to the books below by filename, then by size. Anything that can't be matched is named here, and you can still use the per-book pickers.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectAllUnmatched: couldn't tell which book these are — use the per-book picker for them: {files}
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.statusNote: Books are read live from your files — prose is never stored.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.progressTables: Reading rules tables from your books…
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.abilIntro: {n} abilities available. Books connected this seat: {books}. Abilities always import with their name, classification and page reference; the mechanics and the rules text come from a connected book.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.abilAlias: Its rules text is printed under another entry; it does not stack with that one.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.abilDeprecated: Removed in ACKS II — imports with a caution.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.browseAbilitiesTip: Pick which proficiencies, powers and skills to import, filtered by category and name.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.importAllAbilitiesTip: Import every proficiency, power and skill the cookbook ships, as shared items. Already-imported ones are reused, never duplicated.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.updateAllAbilitiesTip: Refresh every ability in the world — loose items and the copies on actors — against the current cookbook. Ones with no cookbook id are matched by name and adopted.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.collideTitle: Abilities that already have their own text
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.collideIntro: {n} abilit(ies) match a book definition by name only — this module did not create them, and someone has written their descriptions. Updating replaces that text with a page reference. Keeping renames the original out of the way and puts a working reference beside it, so the character holds both.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.collideOverwrite: Replace it with the book reference
